Hero_Desc_Picora:
A witch who loves excessive styling.
After falling in love with the bright and fancy vibe of the surface, she fled the harsh Witch Kingdom and lived in the forest.
Her dream is to someday become a fashion influencer on the surface, acknowledged by all witches.
Album_Like_Picora: The bright light of the surface. Pretty and adorable objects. The witches' food.
Album_Hobby_Picora: Making stickers, shopping in the surface kingdoms.
Album_Picora1: I thought witches only lived underground, but it turns out that some, like Picora, choose to live on the surface. These witches are mostly young ones looking to escape the rigid rules of their society.
Album_Picora2: Picora's outfit is a chaotic mess. It's dizzying to see her clothes covered in stickers and badges. Picora claims to stick stickers over things that look "lame" to cover them up. Meanwhile, anything she finds "cool" gets a specially crafted "Picora Approved" sticker.
Album_Picora3: While talking with Picora, I mentioned a few things about my home planet's items and clothing. She looked at me with sparkling, curious eyes and has been trying to recreate what I described in her own way.
Album_Picora4: Picora mentioned having several mentors in the past. The first was Fricle, but she ran away because she was too strict and boring. The second was Ashur, and the third was Erpin. As for why she decided to take me as her mentor... I don't think I even need to ask.
Album_Picora5: I was invited to a tea party where Picora gathered her witch friends. Picora excitedly showed off cakes from the Sprites, swords from the Werebeasts, and laptops from the Elves, calling them "cutting-edge technology" to the witches. While the witches seemed bewildered and unimpressed, Picora was completely serious.
Album_Picora6: Since Picora was once Fricle's student, she's quite skilled in magic. She quickly figures out how to use unfamiliar items, proving that Fricle had good reason to take her as a disciple. She's just a little stubborn and narrow-minded but undeniably sharp.
Album_Picora7: Picora doesn't seem to like being called a witch. She says it feels like being called a "country bumpkin," revealing some sort of complex. Whenever someone calls her a witch, she secretly slaps a "How rude!" sticker on their back. I once called her a witch too... and later found that sticker stuck to my back.

Mentor, what are you doing?

So much seems to have happened since the day we first met!
I was able to leave the Witch Kingdom and adjust to life on the surface, and later, while helping the Order, I made so many good friends... Hehe, it is all thanks to you!
